name: Randy Weber, Sr.
page_title: Randy Weber, Sr.'s Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (TX) - District 14

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Supreme Court strikes down Roe V. Wade decision in draft of Majority Opinion! If accurate, this is a win for our most innocent and vulnerable - the unborn."

"Today we celebrate the first anniversary of the Dobbs Supreme Court decision that overturned Roe v. Wade. Every unborn child is precious, extraordinary, and worthy of protection. I am proud to stand on the side of LIFE!"
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "How many times do we have to tell y'all that cuts to Medicare and Social Security are off the table?"
"Republicans don't want to cut Social Security & Medicare. Joe Biden must stop his baseless attacks, put his money where his mouth is, and work with Republicans to address the looming crisis."
Rated 0% by Alliance for Retired Americans
Rated 0% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "The positive impact of our #TaxCutsAndJobsAct is undeniable. We lowered individual taxes at every level, doubled the child tax credit, repealed the individual mandate & more. Wages are up, unemployment is down. Most importantly, #YouKeepMore of your hard-earned money."
Rated 93% by National Tax Limitation Committee
Voted in favor of HR 1: "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"

"Well we’re trying to get out of this place today. The Socialistic, Liberal Democrats don’t think they’ve done enough damage; they want to increase taxes! Our MTR is messing w/them! Democrats can’t decide what to do on the floor. Turns out were rubbing "SALT" in their wounds!"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "I will continue working to ensure that Congress fulfills its constitutional mandate to "provide for the common defense" through the necessary funding of our military. "Voted for the Make America Secure Appropriations Act to secure our borders, rebuild our armed forces, increase troop pay, and protect our citizens"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "A $34 trillion debt is not the legacy we should leave for our children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren. This path of recklessness is unsustainable and downright insane. The spending needs to stop."

"I voted AGAINST the clean CR. We are $33 TRILLION in debt & the American people can’t afford to continue Nancy Pelosi’s bloated spending levels. I couldn’t support a CR that does nothing to protect our southern border or cut spending. All it does is kick the can down the road."

"When Republicans earn back the House this November, we will fight America’s inflation crisis by curbing Biden and House Democrats’ out-of-control government spending that is causing the price of groceries, gas, cars, and housing to skyrocket."
Voted against HR 5376: "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Let's be clear, President Biden is not "forgiving" or "canceling" student loan debt. He's simply transferring borrowers' burden to working and middle-class American - many of them didn't go to college or did not take out student loans. This is disastrous."
"Tonight, I voted for a resolution that would rightly exert Congress's authority over the power of the purse while canceling the costly and downright unconstitutional student loan "forgiveness."
Rated 0% by National Education Association

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "The legitimacy of our republic--soon to celebrate two and a half centuries as a beacon of freedom--rests on the foundation that our elections are transparent, fairly administered, and above board," said Weber. "Just as Americans from either side of the aisle are losing faith in our electoral process, the VOTER ID Act implements transparency and audit procedures that aim to restore the trust of our citizens in the integrity of THEIR ballots while honoring the constitution."
Rated 6% by Common Cause
Voted against HR 5746 "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "President Biden’s war on American energy is embarrassing. He takes a gas can down and begs Venezuela and Saudi Aruba for oil. Mr. President…bring your gas can to Texas."

"The Republican's plan for American energy: unleash American energy and restore American energy dominance. The Democrat's plan for American energy: kill the fossil fuel industry and implement the Green New Deal. Choose your fighter."

"Therefore, I think it's obvious that any plan to completely abandon our current infrastructure and energy sources would be a big mistake. That's why a key component of a successful equitable energy transition is an all-of-the-above energy strategy, with a focus on affordable and reliable energy technologies, and keeping traditional energy sources on the table while making them cleaner and more efficient. That means carbon capture, utilization, and sequestration that makes fossil fuels clean. It means keeping our nuclear fleet up and running. It also means incorporating solar, wind, and other renewables into our grid as a piece of the puzzle, instead of mandating an instant and complete transition."
Rated 100% by American Energy Alliance

positions.question: Do you support the federal government allowing permits for drilling on public lands?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by American Energy Alliance

"The United States could produce 48.5 billion barrels of oil offshore in the Gulf of Mexico. Instead...the offshore oil and gas permitting plummets to a 2-decade low under Biden. No surprise here. We need to DRILL here NOW!"
"We should be increasing oil production in Texas - NOT IN VENEZUELA."

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "I just voted NO against Democrats' latest unconstitutional attempt to strip Americans of their Second Amendment rights. In the wake of tragedy, Dems are hell-bent on advancing their radical gun control agenda. The right to keep & bear arms is a cornerstone of American freedom."

"Thomas Jefferson once said that when government fears the people, there is liberty. When the people fear the government, there is tyranny. And I would add fear the government that fears your guns. I will always defend Americans’ right to bear arms"

"We are done sitting back and letting a bunch of faceless bureaucrats destroy the Second Amendment. I will continue to fight for every single law-abiding gun owner. When government fears the people, there is liberty. When the people fear the government, there is tyranny."
Voted against HR 1446 "Enhanced Background Checks Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Under the abysmal failures of President Biden at our southern border, Texas is being forced to foot the bill for the outrageous cost of illegal immigration. We cannot continue to force Texans to pay for criminal cartels, human smugglers, and illegal immigrants to pour across our border while the Biden administration looks the other way. President Biden must take responsibility for the crisis he created."

"Unfortunately, our broken immigration system cannot be called fair. It is not fair to those who patiently wait in line to enter legally. It is not fair to American workers who must compete with illegal immigrants working for artificially low wages. Our broken system and porous borders also leave us less safe. Despite the tireless efforts of our Border Patrol and immigration enforcement officers, drugs and people continue to cross our southern border. We can and must make this system better."
"We must secure our southern border"
Rated 92% by NumbersUSA
